items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Then another time I did some things with playing piano with Johnny and Lawrence, with Aaron Bell on bass and Sonny Greer on drums.

ctx.x: Yeah, but I just never knew he recorded as a conga player.

Yeah. He was playing congas. And I'm playing piano, and it worked quite well. Worked out very good. Then another time I did some things with playing piano with Johnny and Lawrence, with Aaron Bell on bass and Sonny Greer on drums.
